steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: Course set. Drizzles observed. Wayside stations will allow passage.

steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: Incoming telegram from Viscount Dawson. They would like to use this journey as an opportunity to meet with the Dublinn representative.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: More nobles coming over to our side.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Don't you worry. The Leader won't deign to make them any statements.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Did they think a simple show of friendliness would earn them a guarantee of peace from Dublinn, a Taran population kept in check?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I say at some point, they need to learn what constitutes true sincerity.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: The Leader is still sending you to negotiate?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Perhaps I should fritter away some more time, at least enough that people forget about me.

spans.text: fritter away some more time, at least enough that people forget about me.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Good to hear. You've made your share of errors by my standards.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Heheh... well, since you came back to report on your lonesome, I take it you haven't caught Loughshinny yet?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Don't ask rhetorical questions.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: You hindered my ranks in their search, only to then leak her prior trail to my men. Not exactly a smart way to save someone, in your case.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And how do you know it wasn't you I was saving?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: You know, I don't recall The Leader ever saying anything about executing her. Do you?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: The Leader did allow her to roam free. The Leader also allowed me to deal with her at my own discretion.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Don't blame me for being harsh on your friend, Harmonie. In these times, no one in their right mind would let a Draco act freely in Victoria.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Oh, never you mind that. I don't think we were ever that close, anyway.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And you see, I'm about to pay a visit to that medical organization she was holing up in.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Hm-hm-hmm! Maybe, just maybe, I'll be the first to get her.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Wait, a building in the way? Blast this low visibility! How was this not foreseen?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Who signed off on navigation plans? Which team was on survey yesterday?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: It's too late for the fleet to turn. Check for any presence of personnel in the building.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Excellent... Brick and wooden construction, small enough not to pose a threat to the ship's treads. Continue on course.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Oh... would you look at that, another tiny mistake.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: There are always sacrifices to be made in war.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Yes, I gather what you mean. But listen—I have my own sense of 'discretion'.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Loughshinny as a sacrifice? I say that might be too high a price to pay.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: The blood of the Draco still flows in her veins, you see. She remains ever so useful, even with Oripathy.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Yes, I did not bring her back.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: She has no resolve to fight, but is plenty capable of fleeing.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Further to which... we pursued her tracks to where the old Taran palace stood. The fires within the ruins have gone out.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Becoming Infected may have changed her Originium Arts.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: You seem to think it was Oripathy that made her stronger?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Heh... of course not.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: She's my sister. It would be disappointing if she couldn't even hold her own.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Tell me. Who's with her?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: A few vagrants. She calls herself the Leader before them.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Then there's no need to follow her.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Since she has at last awakened, and become aware of her power as a Draco...

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: She will return to me soon.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you sure the long-haul trucks pass through here?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye, I hitched on one when I fled Victoria.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Bagpipe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you remember when I asked you... what the truth you wanted was, and what you wanted to do after learning it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Because you knew things would turn out this way. Most things that happen in Victoria end up as a power struggle like this.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mm, you could say... but it's never the same people involved, each time.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: My feelings still haven't changed. I have to submit my report.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I just wonder, you know... when will any part of Victoria truly accept it?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What can I even do, personally speakin', to speed up that process?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You still want to change Victoria, after all this? It amazes me how you're so...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So what? Stupid? Stubborn?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So strong.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Come on, Chenchen, that's why we've always been friends, na? We fixate on a goal and don't change it easily. Not me, not you, not my leader!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ha. Doesn't seem like a compliment when it's from you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And I've been thinkin' these days, anyway... who's to say someone else's dream can't be achieved, right?

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: (White noise)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're still holding onto that thing Fionn gave you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye. What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let me do it... It's an old radio, and I don't want you to turn it into scrap metal.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There we go.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: ...the attention of all citizens. The conflict in Londinium between Victoria and Kazdel continues to escalate...

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: War has... *static*... broken out...

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: The Duke of Wellington... *static*

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: We ask you make war preparations...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Yes, I'm driving back. I noted nothing unusual during my recon assignment.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: The office I used for my last identity? You needn't worry. I'll erase all trails as soon as I return.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Of course I'll accept promotion from the Duke, if all goes according to plan.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I don't plan to hide it. I'll have abandoned my personal identity and face by that point. Whatever I say to you now under my current guise doesn't matter, does it?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I think I'll get off and take a little walk.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Oh, sir, would you like a wooden doll? I've brought some from a village on the other side of the river. The woman who makes them, excellent craft, bless her old heart.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: No, thank you.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Alright... excuse me, are you from around here?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Er, just thought you looked familiar? Really, I'm sorry, I just settled down, I still don't know the people around here all too well.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: I'm Fionn. Peddler of wares. Let me know if you want to buy or sell anything, and I'll sort it for you.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: I live right there, see? That house, just finished yesterday. It's a little far from the village, but I like it here right next to the road.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Oh, er, there's your car, I see... Do I have the wrong person?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Sorry for bothering you and all, I won't keep you any—
At a massive rumbling, they both turn around.
A huge shadow looms on the horizon, the earth trembling beneath their feet.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: W-What's that sound?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: No. Nonono, what's THAT?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: An army?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Yesterday, 400km away, I signed off on a reconnaissance mission scouting this force.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: All along, I've been of the belief that with his militant vice grip, the Iron Duke is our greatest enemy.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: With his support, Dublinn will incite hatred amongst the population, dragging innocent people into riot and even outright war. We must find a way to check his power.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Hundreds, if not thousands of lives, hinge upon my every move.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: But as for the moment...
He could not let out a sound if he tried.
Rumble. Rumble.
The battle fleet, led by a grand high-speed battleship, sails along its set course.
This is the territory of Duke Caster. She has silently assented to all this, assented to war passing through her roads and across Victoria.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: ...Flee, Taran.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: You built your house in the wrong place.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: W-Why?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: This belt remains the territory of Duke Caster. The boundary is vague, and you have yet to cross it.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: The Marquess of Trent did not switch over to the Duke of Wellington's side come the conclusion of negotiations. Moreover, pressure on the Tarans is set to increase once again.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Perhaps you'll sight those brutal patrol squads again in the next two days. Perhaps they haven't forgotten the appearance of your name in the case files.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Did he mistake the Duke's intentions? Is he simply another pawn sacrificed in this war?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: None of us know the answer.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: And if we did, that lone hut would not be built in a wrong place.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Er, what are you going on about...

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: —Wait, I remember now! You! You're the one who came after us back then!

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: W-What are you trying to...
Fischer does not answer. He simply turns, gets back in the car, and starts the engine.
Behind him, the sound of the tiny brick hut collapsing, and the plaintive cry of the villager, are drowned out in the deep cacophony of the battleship at the head.
